128x128, 12 frames @ 10 fps, plays once; anchor (feet) at 64,98
still warns: frames 1, 2, 3, 4 show no effect at all; check life windows and intensity; trail_7 is drawn behind the sprite and 89% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto); fade_7 is drawn behind the sprite and 89% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto). The user gets it as saved: fix it on step 81a6ad05-76d3-4dcb-b7fe-05fdc0080fa8 and export again with --replace a4bf62c5-a91a-4828-a301-6cee55c4b96b, or say why it is right as it is.
